Read by the brain (backend/site.py) and the page (frontend/src/data/site.ts). Product facts (modules, plans, prices, tax rules, customers) live in data/product.json and are never repeated here. home.eyebrow: HR and payroll for Indian companies
home.headline: Payroll that closes on time, with the tax already right.
home.sub: Paynora runs payroll for every state you operate in, works out TDS under both regimes every month, and keeps PF, ESI and professional tax in order. Built for teams of 20 to 1,000.
home.pains_intro: Four problems we hear on almost every first call.

pains.title: The run takes four days and still has errors
pains.body: Attendance comes from one sheet, leave from another and arrears from an email. Every month someone rebuilds the same formulas and hopes nothing moved.

pains.title: February is lost to proofs
pains.body: Employees send rent receipts and ELSS statements as photos. HR checks them by hand, and the TDS that should have been spread over the year lands in the last two payslips.

pains.title: PF, ESI and PT differ by state
pains.body: Each state has its own professional tax slab, ESI stops at a wage ceiling, and a mismatch shows up months later as a notice.

pains.title: Leave never matches the payslip
pains.body: Leave without balance should become loss-of-pay. When leave lives outside payroll, it only does when someone remembers.

home.modules_title: Everything payroll touches, in one place
home.modules_intro: Ten modules. Starter covers the first six; Growth and Scale add the rest.
home.tax_title: Old regime or new? Paynora shows the working.
home.tax_body: For every employee, Paynora works out tax under both regimes, slab by slab, and recalculates TDS each month as declarations turn into verified proofs.
home.quotes_title: Teams that moved their payroll to Paynora
home.cta_title: See your own payroll in Paynora
home.cta_body: A 30-minute walk-through with someone from our sales team, on your headcount and your states.

modules_page.title: Modules
modules_page.intro: Pick what you need now and add the rest later. Every plan includes the six core modules; Growth adds reimbursements and investment proofs; Scale adds multiple companies and the API.

payroll.headline: Approve payroll in an afternoon, not a week.
payroll.body: Paynora pulls approved leave, arrears and one-time payments into the month's run, works out TDS, PF, ESI and professional tax, and shows you a review screen before anything is paid. When you approve, you get the bank transfer file and the payment register.

employees.headline: One record for every person, from joining to exit.
employees.body: Salary structures by grade, bank details, PAN and UAN, documents and the org chart live on one record. Exits close with a full-and-final settlement worked out from the same data.

leave.headline: Leave that payroll actually reads.
leave.body: Set earned, casual and sick leave policies with monthly accrual and holiday calendars per location. Approved leave without balance becomes loss-of-pay in that month's run on its own.

payslips.headline: Payslips your team can read without asking HR.
payslips.body: Every line on a Paynora payslip says what it is and why it changed. Employees find their slips, leave balances and tax working in the self-service portal, and get a password-protected PDF by email.

tax.headline: TDS under the right regime, every month.
tax.body: Paynora compares the old and new regimes for each employee, spreads the year's tax over the months left, and recalculates when salary, leave or declarations change. Form 16 Part B and the quarterly 24Q data come out of the same numbers.

compliance.headline: PF, ESI and professional tax, state by state.
compliance.body: Provident fund on the wage ceiling or on full basic, ESI for employees up to the ESI ceiling, and professional tax by each state's slab. The PF ECR file is ready every month.

reimbursements.headline: Claims with the bill attached, paid with salary.
reimbursements.body: Employees claim from their phone with a photo of the bill. Managers approve, send back or reject, category limits apply per grade, and approved claims are paid in the next payroll run.

declarations.headline: Proof season, done in two afternoons.
declarations.body: Employees declare 80C, 80D, HRA rent and more at the start of the year and upload proofs before the last quarter. You verify each line, and TDS recalculates from the verified amounts.

multi_entity.headline: Several companies, one login.
multi_entity.body: Run payroll for each legal entity with its own PF, ESI and TAN, and see group-level reports across all of them. The employee directory is shared.

api.headline: Paynora in the rest of your stack.
api.body: Use the REST API and webhooks to connect your HR system, export journals to accounting, and sign in with SAML single sign-on.

calendar._about: The sales team's weekly hours. The calendar shows the next 10 business days (Monday to Friday, skipping the holidays below) starting the day after today, IST. Each slot is 30 minutes.
calendar.taken_rule: A slot is already taken when (epoch_day * 3 + (start_minutes / 30) * 7 + rep_index * 11) mod 5 == 0, where epoch_day counts days since 1970-01-01, start_minutes counts minutes after midnight IST and rep_index is the rep's place in this list from 0. Python (backend/calendar_rules.py) and TypeScript (frontend/src/lib/calendar.ts) both implement it; content/calendar_cases.json pins it.
